ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across >90% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) localized to circular ring scars and distal tip clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-toned pixel field across both lobes. High-contrast white circular rings (rosettes) are spatially distributed across the right lobe. High-intensity pixel clusters are concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an approximate 40-degree angle and a depth roughly equivalent to 1/8th of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration. The left lobe trailing edge displays 6-8 distinct jagged peaks of varying pixel-amplitude. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits more rounded, less frequent peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lower boundary transitioning into a horizontal sweep at the trailing edge, ending in slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distinct clusters of circular white rings (approx. 5-10 units) localized primarily on the right lobe surface, varying in diameter from 10 to 25 pixels.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct vertical high-contrast linear mark (rake mark) located on the right lobe near the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, irregular high-intensity calcified clusters (barnacles) on the distal tips of both lobes; extensive circular scarring across the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetric serration pattern on the left lobe's trailing edge compared to the right lobe's smoother topography.
